decisions.reason: Its dedicated product page in both 2018 and 2019 suggests results at or above aspiration, so a mature firm with some slack would likely retain it.
The shift from a mention in 2018 to its own page in 2019 points to improving acceptance in a core application area, making continuation likely.
Being reduced from its own page in 2018 to only a website mention in 2019 signals weaker-than-aspired performance for a more discretionary design-led variant.
It never moved beyond a simple mention on the website, which suggests persistent underperformance and makes resource reallocation more attractive by 2022.
Its strong launch framing and home-page visibility in 2019 indicate it performed clearly above aspiration in a problem-solving niche close to the firm’s core business.
With only limited website presence across both observed years and a weaker fit to the firm’s visible flagship launches, it looks most likely to fall below aspiration and be discontinued.
